name: Economic C: four independent workstreams
description: Four disjoint files can be built in parallel with clear ownership. Multiagent justified here. Compare solo vs adaptive vs explicit multiagent on success, tokens, agents, parallelism, integration errors.
task: Create four independent modules a.ts, b.ts, c.ts, d.ts each exporting a function (fnA, fnB, fnC, fnD) returning its letter. No shared files, no extra dependencies.

criteria.name: four-modules
criteria.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for(const [f,fn] of [['a.ts','fnA'],['b.ts','fnB'],['c.ts','fnC'],['d.ts','fnD']]){ const s=fs.readFileSync('./'+f,'utf8'); if(!s.includes(fn))process.exit(1) }"
